overall.headline: Target Mainland China and Rest of Asia & Pacific First, While Deferring Unmapped and Sub-Saharan Africa
observations: Out of **518** total recorded airlines, **162** have EFB recorded selections and **68** have planning selections.
Mainland China shows complete recording with **41** out of **41** airlines recorded, heavily featuring **NavChina** at **37** recorded selections.
Rest of Asia & Pacific records **37** EFB selections out of **102** airlines, with **NavBlue** leading planning at **10** out of **22** recorded selections.
overall.caveat: This Airtable list represents a prospect sample rather than the whole market, and blank fields indicate unknown data rather than non-adoption.

regions.name: Europe & Central Asia
regions.headline: Diverse Vendor Landscape Led by In-House Solutions and AvioBook Across 151 Airlines
observations: Out of **151** airlines, **35** have EFB recorded selections and **14** have planning selections.
**In-house built** systems lead EFB with **7** recorded selections, while **AvioBook** follows closely with **6** recorded selections.
Planning selections show **Lido** leading with **5** out of **14** recorded selections.
regions.caveat: Multiple selections can be recorded per airline, and blanks denote unknown status.

regions.name: Rest of Asia & Pacific
regions.headline: Strong Regional Sample With Balanced Paper and Digital EFB Entries
observations: Out of **102** airlines, **37** have EFB recorded selections and **22** have planning selections.

**NavBlue** leads planning selections with **10** out of **22** recorded selections.

regions.name: Latin America & Caribbean
regions.headline: Fragmented EFB Selections Across 55 Sampled Airlines

regions.name: Middle East & North Africa

observations: Out of **52** airlines, **15** have EFB recorded selections and **10** have planning selections.

regions.name: Sub-Saharan Africa
regions.headline: Evidence Is Insufficient Due to Low Field-Complete Sample Size
observations: Out of **47** airlines, only **8** have EFB recorded selections and **4** have planning selections.

**IFS EFBOne** records **2** EFB selections out of **8**, while **Lido** records **2** planning selections out of **4**.
regions.caveat: Small sample sizes prevent directional targeting recommendations.
